newsitem.title: FINLAND: IVO says Thai affiliate wins power purchase deal.
newsitem.headline: IVO says Thai affiliate wins power purchase deal.

text.p: Finnish state-owned power producer Imatran Voima (IVO) said on Monday its Thai affiliate Union Power Development Company had signed a key power purchase agreement with the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand.
IVO has a 15 percent stake in the Union Power Development Company which is building a coal power plant for 6.3 billion markka, 25 percent financed with equity.
"The power purchase agreement (with the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand) is the cornerstone for the implementation of the project," IVO said.
IVO said it would assume responsibility for the operation and maintenance of the planned plant and its share of the investment would be about 236 million markka.
IVO's partners in the venture are Union Energy of Thailand and Japanese Tomen, it said.
